name: Radscorpion Egg
blurb: Every known world spawn for Radscorpion Eggs, grouped by region. Directions and photos are added by hand.

world_spawns.note: 24 LPI spawn points (all interior — Carleton Mine) roll a per-server-hop chance each (computed).

creature_drops.note: Radscorpion kills have a chance to drop 1 egg (entry 3, ChanceNone 75). Same rate for Prime radscorpions.

whitespring.note: Whitespring food vendor can stock 1 radscorpion egg from its unique food pool (per-reset chance computed).

consumption.note: Radscorpion Egg is a food consumable. It grants no timed stat buff on its own.
